title: SCPN IEC Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the gridded IEC and Polywell configurations within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype with three implemented capabilities: a validated device configuration model with documented consistency estimates, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, and level-0 device physics of a declared spherical cathode grid (its geometry, aperture count, transparency and the geometric bound on ion recirculation). All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
